name: qlrisk_pnl_explain
title: P&L explain
description: Explain a book's P&L between two market states: actual full-revaluation P&L per trade split into theta (time decay), per-risk-class and per-factor Taylor contributions, and the unexplained remainder. The end state is end_market_data, or the start market plus end_shocks, and end_valuation_date for the time roll. Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades, end_shocks, end_valuation_date; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, end_market_data) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "EquityOption", "trade_id": "SPX-P", "maturity": "6M", "notional": 1000000, "ticker": "SPX", "strike": 5000, "option_type": "put", "counterparty_id": "BANK-B"}], "end_shocks": [{"factor": "EQ.SPX", "size": -0.05, "shock_type": "relative"}]} gives P&L 2026-10-09 -> 2026-10-09: actual 20,346.77 USD, theta 0.00, unexplained 197.69 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
